name: external-research-fleet
description: Orchestrator-workers variant of external-research: parallel workers each synthesize one angle of a research question, merged into one EXTERNAL_RESEARCH.md. Use when the research question has N >= 3 distinct angles or source-groups AND would benefit from parallel deep reads. Do not use when 1-3 sources suffice (use external-research inline), when one source already dominates (no parallelism gain), or when sources have not yet been captured (run capture-references first).
